success.description: 4: One magic effect affecting the target is cancelled.
Two magic effects affecting the target are cancelled.
All magic effects affecting the target are cancelled.

boon.description: The caster of any magic effects cancelled by this spell suffers 1 stress token for each.

conservative.requirements: 6 power, target within close range. The target must be under the effect of a spell with the Ongoing trait, a brief condition granted by a spell, or a similar effect. Special: This spell is an opposed check vs. the Spellcraft of the character who wishes to destroy it. The difficulty is set by the GM.

success.description: 1: One magic effect affecting the target is cancelled.
As above, and the caster of that effect suffers 1 stress and adds 2 recharge tokens to the spell that generated the effect.

boon.description: The caster of any magic effects cancelled by this spell suffers 1 stress and adds 2 recharge tokens to that spell.

reckless.requirements: 6 power, target within close range. The target must be under the effects of a spell with the Ongoing trait, a brief condition granted by a spell, or a similar effect. Special: This spell is an opposed check vs. the Spellcraft of the character who generated the effect you wish to destroy. If the effect is 'naturally occurring,' then the difficulty is set by the GM.
